title: アオハル杯5戦目・決戦を終えて

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Wooooo!

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: I lost!

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: Ohh, and after everyone did their best out there, too… This must be because of my bad luck! I've ruined everything again!

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text: Wow, that was close! But I had so much fun!

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text: We'll have to try even harder next time and win together as a team, 'kay, Rice?

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: Urara…

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: Okay! We'll get it next time for sure!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: The heated races inject a hefty dose of excitement into the crowd!

text_block_list.name: Umamusume A
text_block_list.text: We can't give up either! We're gonna go all out in our next race!

text_block_list.name: Umamusume B
text_block_list.text: That was a great race! I wanted both teams to win!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Ms. Kashimoto sits among the cheering crowd, her eyes fixed on a single point.

text_block_list.name: Riko Kashimoto
text_block_list.text: So… we won, then.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Just then…

text_block_list.name: Bitter Glasse
text_block_list.text: Trainer Kashimoto! Did you see us out there?! Listen to this!

text_block_list.name: Bitter Glasse
text_block_list.text: We timed ourselves this morning! I clocked 2 minutes 24.5 seconds, Little Cocon got 3 minutes 4.8 seconds, and…

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Bitter Glasse reads out the team's best times in a rush.

text_block_list.name: Bitter Glasse
text_block_list.text: We all ran faster than our target times! And we all felt satisfied with our race performance, so please—

text_block_list.name: Little Cocon
text_block_list.text: Please come back to us as our trainer!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Suddenly, Little Cocon is in the stands too, breathless and flushed.

text_block_list.name: Riko Kashimoto
text_block_list.text: Little Cocon!

text_block_list.name: Little Cocon
text_block_list.text: The reason I was able to beat my target time was because there's something I sought to change!

text_block_list.name: Little Cocon
text_block_list.text: You mean so much to me as a trainer, and I admire you so much!

text_block_list.name: Little Cocon
text_block_list.text: That's why I wanted to destroy the misguided beliefs you've clung on to for so long!

text_block_list.name: Little Cocon
text_block_list.text: We are so, so grateful that you watched over and managed us so wholeheartedly.

text_block_list.name: Little Cocon
text_block_list.text: But from now on…

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Little Cocon takes a deep breath to calm herself down.

text_block_list.name: Little Cocon
text_block_list.text: We want you to treat us as equals as we work toward our goals!

text_block_list.name: Little Cocon
text_block_list.text: We want to work with you as partners on equal standing, not children that need to be micromanaged!

text_block_list.name: Little Cocon
text_block_list.text: That's all I… That's all we want.

text_block_list.name: Riko Kashimoto
text_block_list.text: Partners on equal standing… Yes, you're right.

text_block_list.name: Riko Kashimoto
text_block_list.text: I watched you all race. Every one of you was incredible. It made me realize none of you need me anymore.

text_block_list.name: Little Cocon
text_block_list.text: That's not tru—

text_block_list.name: Riko Kashimoto
text_block_list.text: But at the same time, I felt a strong desire to see what lies ahead.

text_block_list.name: Riko Kashimoto
text_block_list.text: To discover what the future holds for you all.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Ms. Kashimoto's eyes finally regain a small sparkle of light.

text_block_list.name: Riko Kashimoto
text_block_list.text: You all ran with such will and determination on the track today. To say you exceeded my expectations would be an understatement.

text_block_list.name: Riko Kashimoto
text_block_list.text: It's been a very long time since I've felt this way.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Ms. Kashimoto casts an affectionate eye over the empty track.

text_block_list.name: Riko Kashimoto
text_block_list.text: It's as you said. I need to be less scared… and have more faith.

text_block_list.name: Riko Kashimoto
text_block_list.text: I need to learn to trust my runners as well as myself.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Ms. Kashimoto heads down with Little Cocon to the track where Team Zenith awaits.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: The next day, Ms. Kashimoto announces that she's calling off Operation Oversight and stepping down from her position as temporary director.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: What's more, in light of the possibility of future Unity Cup events and the positive effects that team training has shown, it's decided that all registered teams are to remain together.

text_block_list.name: Riko Kashimoto
text_block_list.text: Seeing my racers for who they really are and having an earnest conversation with them opened my eyes to many things.

text_block_list.name: Riko Kashimoto
text_block_list.text: I want to do better and start afresh.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Ms. Kashimoto holds herself with a more relaxed air than before. It's clear that she's finally come to terms with something deep within herself.
choice_data_list: What are you going to do now?

text_block_list.name: Riko Kashimoto
text_block_list.text: Thanks to Director Akikawa's generosity, I've been allowed to work here as a trainer once more.

text_block_list.name: Riko Kashimoto
text_block_list.text: I hope to share the battleground with you and your trainee again—this time in the Twinkle Series.

text_block_list.name: Riko Kashimoto
text_block_list.text: I'm looking forward to our next race.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Ms. Kashimoto quietly leaves my office with a faint smile on her lips.

text_block_list.name: Bitter Glasse
text_block_list.text: Oh, are you finally done with your talk, Trainer Kashimoto? I wanted to ask you something about tomorrow's training, but—

text_block_list.name: Little Cocon
text_block_list.text: Hey, not so fast! I got here first!

text_block_list.name: Riko Kashimoto
text_block_list.text: It's rude to yell in the corridor, you two. You can ask me when we get to my office.

text_block_list.name: Riko Kashimoto
text_block_list.text: You'll both get a chance to speak, so there's no need to rush.

text_block_list.name: Cocon and Glasse
text_block_list.text: Thank you, Trainer Kashimoto!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: I can hear the three of them continue to chatter excitedly even as their footsteps fade into the distance.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Now that Ms. Kashimoto has overcome her past, I'm sure her future with her racers will be bright.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: She'll be an incredible rival in my future endeavors, so I'll have to continue working hard until the day comes to face her again!
